entities.name: Ixhel
entities.description: Phyrexian angel of New Phyrexia made by Atraxa as a weapon and creator of Vishgraz.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: Praetor-like Phyrexian angel created by Elesh Norn, creator of Ixhel.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor who created Atraxa and turned her eye to the Multiverse.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Thane who made contracts with aspirants and was decapitated by Ixhel.

entities.name: Vishgraz
entities.description: Phyrexian creature made by Ixhel from the bodies of Geth and Belaxis.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: Phyrexian sect that raised Ixhel and Atraxa.

events.summary: Atraxa creates Ixhel in her image and commands her to subdue the other praetors; Ixhel grows more intelligent as realms fall.
events.quote: Atraxa created Ixhel in her image and commanded Ixhel to go forth and subdue the other praetors.

events.summary: Atraxa sends Ixhel to assassinate Geth; after he sows doubts, Ixhel decapitates him.
events.quote: after a short fight, Ixhel decapitated him

events.summary: Ixhel kills Belaxis and uses his and Geth's bodies to create Vishgraz.
events.quote: killed one of Geth's underlings named Belaxis

events.summary: Atraxa, disgusted that Ixhel thought for herself, orders Vishgraz gotten rid of; Ixhel abandons him in the Dross Pits.
events.quote: Ixhel abandoned Vishgraz in the Dross Pits
